# Missing / re-record audio — canonical list
**Generated by `python toolkit/missing-audio.py` — do not hand-edit.** Regenerate after every wiring wave; content.js is the source of truth.
- **0** cards are SILENT (never recorded)
- **1** cards are voiced but flagged for RE-RECORDING by a native speaker
- **8** further cards reuse one of those clips and are fixed for free

---

## 1. Silent — needs a first recording

Filename = the exact `tsw` string, which is what the tagger and enhance bot expect.

---

## 2. Re-record when a native speaker is available

Megan recorded these herself on 2026-07-17 and ran them through the Adobe enhance bot; on 2026-07-18 she judged that batch's quality poor. **They stay wired in the app meanwhile** — this is a quality upgrade, not a gap. Re-recording writes over the same `audio/items/<id>.mp3` filenames, so that wave **will** change existing bytes and **will** need `AUDIO_CACHE` (`relefela-audio-vN`) bumped in `sw.js` — unlike a new-files-only export, which must not bump it.
